import time

def classify(tweet, model, classifier):

    emb = model.encode(tweet.text)
    pred = classifier.predict(emb)
    latency = time.time() - t0
    return pred, latency
```

## Code Example

import re
EMOJI_MAP = {":)": "smile"}
def normalize(text):
  for k,v in EMOJI_MAP.items():
    text = text.replace(k, v)
  text = re.sub(r"[^\w\s]", "", text)
  return text.lower()
```
